description: Eastern Province - Declaring that Hon. Ibrahim Mohamed Mohemed Monsoor, Minister of Health & Indigenous Medicine, etc. & Hon. Ahamed Nazeer Zainulabdeen, Minister of Agriculture etc. resigned from their respective portfolios effective from 01.01.2015
categorisation: This gazette names specific individuals (Hon. Ibrahim Mohamed Mohamed Monsoor and Hon. Ahamed Nazeer Zainulabdeen) and provides detailed descriptions of their ministerial portfolios and responsibilities, including specific subject areas they were responsible for (Health, Indigenous Medicine, Social Welfare, Agriculture, Animal Production, etc.). This combination of named individuals with detailed portfolio responsibilities qualifies it as a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
